episodes.title: Part 1
episodes.summary: A runt pig named Wilbur tries to navigate farm life after being saved by a young girl named Fern. When Wilbur learns that he is being raised for slaughter, he turns to a new friend for help: a witty and wise barn spider named Charlotte.

episodes.title: Part 2
episodes.summary: In the wake of Charlotte's miraculous web message, Wilbur and Fern embrace their newfound celebrity. But a twist of fortune puts Wilbur's fate back into question, sending Charlotte and the barn animals on another quest to save him.

episodes.title: Part 3
episodes.summary: Charlotte, Wilbur, Fern, and family are off to the County Fair! Will Wilbur win the blue ribbon and ensure his life is saved? Can Charlotte help by spinning a message in her web that's greater than any she's spun before?
